models.description: This dataset, from the IEEE Signal Processing Cup 2015, aims to estimate heart rate from wrist-worn PPG and accelerometer sensors during intense physical exercise. It features 3096 five-dimensional time series segments, sampled at 125Hz. Ground truth heart rate is derived from simultaneous ECG recordings. The dataset includes two PPG channels, three accelerometer channels, and a corresponding ECG signal for each subject.  Subjects were aged 18-35, and PPG signals were collected from the wrist using two pulse oximeters with green LEDs (515nm wavelength) spaced 2cm apart. The competitive nature of the Cup makes this a particularly rigorous dataset focused on distinguishing physiological signals from motion artifacts.
